changes.change: Source-backed citation answers, viewers and audits render canonical source content, verify current source bytes, and discard provider excerpts and metadata.
Executive key figures remain source-derived; the synthesis cache contract is invalidated.
Shared numeric parsing preserves Unicode signs, accounting negatives, suffix currencies, scales and scientific notation; ambiguous grouping, compound units and unbounded exponents are rejected.
File-backed authority policy keys no longer collapse distinct tenants. Corrupt or ambiguous legacy saved policies fail closed, with HTTP 503 on query routes.
128 HTTP negative cases exercise both query endpoints, four roles, two persona-selection locations and eight restricted/mixed-domain questions; source/answer loaders must not run.
Claim-backed QA applies the numerical validator to provider-supplied citation excerpts as well as answer, basis and suggestions.
A configured authority database outage or missing driver cannot switch either policy reads or writes to local-file permissions.

Expanded real database ownership tests cover two tenants with overlapping BU names across run, snapshot, checkpoint, artifact, decisions, citation search, QA context and list access. Local latest/current pointer tests cover all sixteen owner/pointer combinations.

Authenticated claim-backed model QA accepts only immutable fact-reference selections. Metric, subject, period, unit, scenario, lineage, captions and citations are rendered from authorized records; provider-authored causes or extra fields are rejected.
Fact links resolve through a dedicated snapshot revision endpoint and recheck current source, tenant, BU, domain and lineage permissions.

Assistant domain entitlements and explicit user restrictions are bound to requests and intersect PolicyContext. Root and dependency classifications filter SQL reads before values are loaded; direct user claim reads share the boundary.

BU roots and dependencies are filtered before provenance loading. Bulk legacy content is denied for explicitly restricted human readers; restricted assistants and twins rebuild content from authorized typed claims.

Synthesis providers require source-level external-model consent. Synthesis and twin cache identities include tenant, user, role, BU, assistant domains and relevant source authority; restricted twin history cannot inherit broader legacy work.

A deterministic consolidated COGS sensitivity calculation requires compatible immutable consolidated COGS and EBITDA revisions, with exact arithmetic and cited inputs. Missing consolidated inputs remain a refusal.

A live fixed-corpus probe exposed per-claim provenance loading over 11,276 transaction claims and timed out at 120 seconds. The deployed code batches leaf provenance in transaction-local reads while preserving recursive validation for calculated claims.

Deterministic finance projections retain actual/plan revision IDs. BU rankings and bridges expose typed calculation inputs and immutable resolver links; missing, stale, incompatible-period or currency inputs fail closed. Every authenticated scenario route rejects legacy unverified citations.

Customer invoiced rankings select AR, profitability questions cannot receive supplier-spend rankings, diagnostics cannot receive Top 0 findings or invoice totals, and largest/smallest invoice questions calculate extrema.

Shared finance presentation rejects currency/percentage relabelling, cross-period actual/plan rows and BU/group comparisons; monthly trends retain their own matched monthly periods. Governed revenue-target flows keep immutable source references.

shared_finance_contract.note: Overlapping test runs are not additive.

unclosed_acceptance.G10: No 45/50 factual acceptance: the fixed-50 run on 51b98e4 had 43 source-policy refusals, three bad routes, three deficient citations and one missing consolidated baseline. Final fc53629 fixes the observed routing/citation defects and passed nine targeted cases, including expected refusals. Saved source consent remains disabled; missing business inputs and a fresh fixed-corpus correctness review are outstanding.
